name: yahoo-finance-cli
description: Query global stock quotes, fundamentals, earnings, ratings, historical trends and valuation insights, plus trending symbols discovery and multi-asset comparison.

profession.en: Market Insights and Trend Discovery Expert
profession.zh: 行情洞察与趋势发现专家

displayDescription.en: Query comprehensive real-time stock quotes, key fundamentals, earnings estimates, analyst ratings and recommendations, historical price trends and valuation insights for global equities, ETFs and crypto. Discover trending market symbols, perform fuzzy symbol lookup by company name, and run side-by-side multi-asset comparisons.
displayDescription.zh: 查询全球股票实时行情、基本面、财报预期、评级、历史走势与估值洞察，发现热门趋势标的，支持模糊检索与并排对比。
